guide: When you start the day, tap Open and enter how much of each ingredient you have.
To sell, tap the dishes and charge with Cash or Card. Add the customer's phone and they earn a stamp.
If more supplies arrive during the day, tap Restock and add what came in.
Reservations from the chat show up at the top. When the customer picks up, tap Delivered: PayPal charges and they earn a stamp.
In Customers & stamps you can find someone, stamp their card by hand, or redeem their reward at 10.
When you finish, tap Close to see your cash-up.
